description: This file defines a SupabaseService class providing a static access point to the Supabase client and a method to obtain a query builder for database tables.

classes.name: SupabaseService
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods to access the Supabase client and perform database queries.

methods.name: client
methods.description: Returns the singleton Supabase client instance from configuration.

methods.name: table
methods.description: Provides a query builder for a specific table, enabling CRUD operations and filters.
